item.title: Antarctica
item.description: Antarctica has got to be one of the most ethereal places on earth. With an area of ≈5.5M sq mi (≈14.2M km²) it is 98% ice-covered, ≈13.9M km² of which is ice, with an average ice thickness of 2.16 km and a total ice volume of 26.5M km³. Antarctica holds ≈70% of Earth's total fresh water, ≈90% of all the ice on earth, and ≈9.5% of the global land area.
